avoid_supplements.name: Chromium picolinate
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate insulin effects and cause hypoglycemia by enhancing insulin sensitivity
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; monitor blood glucose closely if used together

avoid_supplements.name: Fenugreek seeds
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Increases insulin sensitivity and delays gastric emptying, increasing hypoglycemia risk
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue or use only under close medical supervision with glucose monitoring

avoid_supplements.name: Bitter melon extract
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Enhances insulin secretion and glucose uptake, potentiating hypoglycemic effect
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid use; counsel patient on hypoglycemia risk if inadvertently combined

caution_supplements.name: Cinnamon
caution_supplements.mechanism: May modestly improve insulin sensitivity; limited clinical evidence but potential additive effect
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood glucose; dose adjustment of insulin may be needed

caution_supplements.name: Alpha-lipoic acid
caution_supplements.mechanism: May enhance glucose utilization and reduce insulin resistance
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for hypoglycemia; educate patient on symptoms

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: May lower blood glucose through enhanced insulin secretion
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood glucose regularly; inform healthcare provider of use

avoid_foods.name: High glycemic index foods (refined sugars, white bread, pastries)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Rapid glucose absorption overwhelms insulin lispro's onset, causing hyperglycemia or excessive post-prandial spikes
avoid_foods.action: Counsel patient on carbohydrate counting and low-to-moderate glycemic index food selection

avoid_foods.name: Alcohol (especially on empty stomach)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Impairs hepatic glucose production and potentiates hypoglycemic effect of insulin
avoid_foods.action: Advise abstinence or minimal consumption with food; educate on hypoglycemia awareness

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: Delays gastric emptying, prolonging insulin-glucose mismatch and increasing risk of delayed hypoglycemia
caution_foods.action: Advise patient to monitor glucose response; may require insulin timing adjustment

caution_foods.name: Simple carbohydrates with fiber (fruit, legumes)
caution_foods.mechanism: Fiber slows glucose absorption; insulin lispro timing should align with actual carbohydrate absorption
caution_foods.action: Educate on appropriate carb counting; monitor glucose response to optimize dosing

monitoring_notes: Insulin lispro users require consistent carbohydrate intake and meal timing synchronization with injection; blood glucose self-monitoring is essential to detect hypoglycemia and adjust dosing for supplements or dietary changes. Healthcare provider should review all supplements and dietary modifications to prevent dangerous insulin-glucose dysregulation.
